rules.order: nonchronological: F1 F2 F3 are the day of the departure, F4 jumps 'later', F5 jumps back to a season; screen order ≠ remembered order
rules.voice: captions only; no TTS, no recorded speech
remembered_time_types: Exact (only with evidence_id in evidence register)
rules.inferred_display: every inferred link shows 'INFÉRÉ' on screen within its caption window and inferred=true in the ledger
rules.silence: no caption, record line or voice in 44.0–52.0 (declared silence); the card 52–57 carries the record, not the voice

typography.record_line: muted mono 13 px, below the gloss
typography.slate: 13 px muted mono top-left (DejaVu Sans Mono / IBM Plex Mono), present-tense claims only; never italic serif

speakers.name: la narratrice / le narrateur (adulte, fictif)
speakers.note: No real person. Voice is caption only (no TTS, no recorded speech).

lamp_states.A: stage morning, upper left, low warm
lamp_states.M: memory: cold blue-grey, upper left, own haze; not a stage state

fragments.speaker: N1
fragments.text_fr: Le numéro sept. La porte était lourde ; je l'ai tirée seule.
fragments.gloss_en: Number seven. The door was heavy; I pulled it alone.

remembered_time.label: un matin, avant huit heures ? (heure incertaine)

place_link.basis: the narrator names the number seven, which the plaque on screen also shows; a narrative assertion inside the fiction, not a geographic claim

layout.zone: low, over the plinth / ground strip; no band behind text, light 1 px dark halo only for legibility (no box)

fragments.speaker: N1
fragments.text_fr: À l'angle, j'ai suivi la rigole entre les pavés, à gauche. Ou bien à droite.
fragments.gloss_en: At the corner I followed the gutter seam between the cobbles, left. Or right.

remembered_time.label: le même jour, plus tard (ordre incertain)

place_link.basis: the corner and the seam are the junction's cue; direction (left/right) is explicitly uncertain

layout.zone: low, over the plinth / ground strip; no band behind text, light 1 px dark halo only for legibility (no box)

p02_recatalogue_check.against_source: JUNC-M (Marville, Rue Tirechappe, c. 1860: kerb + gutter seam up the setts, forking)
p02_recatalogue_check.note: Wording changed from 'la couture du trottoir' to 'la rigole entre les pavés' to match the setts and gutter seam of the P02 source chosen by U1. Merge is unblocked for either source.

fragments.speaker: N1
fragments.text_fr: Ce banc, ou un autre. J'ai attendu longtemps ; qui, je ne sais plus.
fragments.gloss_en: This bench, or another. I waited a long time; for whom, I no longer know.

remembered_time.label: inconnu (durée : une heure ou un jour)

place_link.basis: 'ce banc, ou un autre': the narrator does not assert this is the bench; the link is the film's inference

layout.zone: low, over the plinth / ground strip; no band behind text, light 1 px dark halo only for legibility (no box)

fragments.speaker: N1
fragments.text_fr: Plus tard, on m'a dit que j'avais neuf ans.
fragments.gloss_en: Later I was told I was nine.

place_link.basis: no place is named; the fragment is a jump in time, not a claim about the door

confidence.note: the narrator reports what someone else said; 'nine' is the third party's figure, kept as the interval 8–10

fragments.provenance: hearsay (an unnamed third party, quoted by the fictional narrator; fiction written for this work)

layout.zone: low, over the plinth / ground strip; no band behind text, light 1 px dark halo only for legibility (no box)

fragments.note: Ends as the leaves begin to open (31.0); the voice is not synced as cause of the opening (I3): it ends on the frame the motion starts, never on a leaf contact.

fragments.speaker: N1
fragments.text_fr: Le banc, c'était l'hiver, à peu près.
fragments.gloss_en: The bench: it was winter, roughly.

place_link.basis: the bench is the one of shot 3 only by the film's inference; spoken over P01, it is dislocated

dislocation.memory_light: M (cold, upper left, its own light; not lamp A or B)
